name: smwpatches-limited-boo-range
title: Limited Boo Range
description:
Boos and Big Boos will no longer be separated from their initial position by more than a certain distance. This prevents sprite-over by inducing a large number of Boos.
This effect does not appear on the Block Boos.

You can also change the trackable distance according to the value of RAM.(Set between $0000 and $7FFF. If you set it to $0000, it will follow you everywhere.)
